model.summary: Model favors CLE by 0.8 points (55% win chance). Biggest factors: Offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (CLE +3.3), Rushing offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (BAL +2.8), Elo rating (BAL +2.6). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 41.7 total points (CLE 21, BAL 20). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 1.4), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (lowers total 1.0), Divisional game (lowers total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
